copy.short: Limited gates. Stack ≥ 50% on the goal. The camera punishes a pawn-walk.
copy.detail: You have 8 coin operations and 6 walks. A bare walk to the right is observed at cell 6. H, then ride the right-moving packet without remashing H, can put 50% on the exit — the left packet is a trap. Z and S change later interference. Then Measure.
